Name: DGR 014 - Lukysis
Information:
**DGR 014 - LUKYSIS**

A DGR created as a slow but steady defensive unit, meant to withstand and mitigate the danger from Luxus and Harros specifically. This defensive unit is a powerful artillery unit that is equipped with particularly thick armor.

Information Sections.Title: DGR 014 - LUKYSIS
Information Sections.Text: A DGR created as a slow but steady defensive unit, meant to withstand and mitigate the danger from Luxus and Harros specifically. This defensive unit is a powerful artillery unit that is equipped with particularly thick armor.

traits.name: Nova Absorption
traits.description: When the DGR or any creature within 30 feet of it would take fire damage, the fire damage is reduced to half (before immunities and resistances are considered), and the DGR gains temporary hit points equal to the fire damage it specifically would have taken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Shield Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are knocked prone.

actions.name: Nova Flares
actions.description: Four creatures the DGR chooses within 240 feet have a series of fiery strikes launched at them, and must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, each takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Union Beam (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The DGR fires a 20-foot wide, 240-foot long beam of pure light originating from itself. Each creature in that space must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) fire damage and 33 (6d10) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Radiant Barrier (1/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The DGR generates a powerful barrier around itself and each of its allies within 60 feet. Each creature gains 55 (10d10) temporary hit points which remain for 1 minute, and while they have them each creature is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. If the DGR is killed or incapacitated, the temporary hit points disappear early.
